conventions.convention: The static spherical metric uses signature (−,+,+,+), length coordinate x⁰=ct, areal radius r, positive b, and mass M=c²r(1−b)/(2G). Pressure and energy density have SI units J m⁻³.
The geometric supplier chain assumes ZF plus Countable Choice, rather than unrestricted Choice.

The supplied barotropic EOS is smooth and positive on an open positive-pressure interval. The constant-density preparation separately supplies its constant smooth extension through zero pressure and prescribes vacuum independently.

The constant-density family has strict compactness range 0<u<8/9. Its C¹, piecewise-C² interface is established in a proper-radial matching chart; global smoothness in the areal-radius coordinate is not asserted.

Entropy variations fix R, proper particle number N_b, and spherical mass-energy E=c²M(R), use positive even C² profiles with compact state-chart range and uniformly positive b, and normalize the boundary lapse by e^φ(R)=√b(R). Stationarity concerns first variations along the explicitly defined constraint-preserving curves.

The subsystem uses Gibbs-volume entropy S_G=k_B log Ω at a strictly interior regulated Kepler branch energy. The logarithmic bath and scalar law dx/dt=L S_tot′, L>0, are separately adopted assumptions. A Newtonian physical interpretation retains the upstream slow-motion restriction.

load_bearing.statement: Adopts the Λ=0 Einstein equation with static isotropic mixed stress diag(−𝓔(P),P,P,P), a supplied smooth positive EOS 𝓔:I_P→(0,∞), and b>0 on each open fluid interval; it asserts no smoothness across a vacuum interface.

For a smooth positive EOS on an open positive-pressure interval, a nonempty compact central-pressure interval with a closed pressure margin, and fixed central lapse, the stated even Volterra profiles exist uniquely on a common interval, are smooth, satisfy b≥1/2, and give a C² Cartesian metric center under ZF plus Countable Choice.

Under the constant-density preparation and its mathematical supplier, the displayed interior profiles and vacuum exterior solve the adopted model, have a regular center, and join C¹ and piecewise C² without delta-supported surface stress for 0<u<8/9; P(0)=ε₀(1−a)/(3a−1), a=√(1−u).

Supplies a compatible C² local entropy chart, positive even C² profiles, proper entropy and particle-number functionals, fixed spherical mass-energy and radius, uniformly positive b, and the stated boundary clock for a separate static isotropic Einstein-fluid preparation.

On its fixed-radius, positive-b profile domain, constrained entropy stationarity is equivalent to constant μ/Θ, Θe^φ and μe^φ, with φ defined by the lapse integral and boundary normalization; in that case the TOV pressure equation holds. This proves first-variation criticality only.

Selects an interior negative-capacity Gibbs-volume Kepler state, a logarithmic bath matched at T_*>0 with 0<C_b<|C_G|, conserved total energy, and the separately adopted scalar exchange law dx/dt=L S_tot′.
At the prepared matched-temperature point, S_tot″(x_*)=−T_*⁻²(1/C_G+1/C_b)<0. The selected exchange ODE has a forward-invariant local basin with exponential attraction, and dS_tot/dt=L(S_tot′)²≥0.

alerts.finding: Proof step 2.2 says: “for b=0 there is no time dependence and every mixed time-radial Christoffel is zero”. This wording is false: the metric gives Γ⁰₀r=φ′ and Γʳ₀₀=b e^(2φ)φ′, generally nonzero; step 1.1 lists these symbols. The zero time component of the diagonal source divergence requires only the relevant Γᵃₐ₀ terms to vanish, so the stated reduction survives this explanatory error.
